description: This file defines structures and functions related to resource limits (ulimits) in Go, including parsing ulimit strings and converting to Rlimit structures.

classes.name: Ulimit
classes.description: A human-friendly representation of resource limits, including soft and hard limits.

classes.name: Rlimit
classes.description: Resource limit structure used for system calls, representing type, soft, and hard limits.

methods.name: ParseUlimit
methods.description: Parses a string to create a Ulimit object, validating limits and types.

methods.name: Ulimit.GetRlimit
methods.description: Converts a Ulimit object into an Rlimit structure for system calls.

methods.name: Ulimit.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Ulimit object.
